stock.description: Universe Printshop Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding entity, offering a broad spectrum of printing solutions and engaging in the distribution of various printed goods throughout Hong Kong. Its operational capabilities encompass diverse printing technologies, including conventional offset, modern inkjet, and advanced toner-based digital methods. Beyond these services, the firm supplies an extensive array of printed items, both for corporate clients—such as stationery, advertising collateral, periodicals, directories, and brochures—and other miscellaneous products like self-inking stamps, PVC business cards, customized eco-friendly bags, and branded plastic folders. The company was founded in 2001 and maintains its principal corporate office in Kwun Tong, Hong Kong.
